snippet.title: Nami no Iro - The Color of The Waves [Launch Trailer]
snippet.description:
"Nami no Iro - The Color of The Waves" is a psychological horror visual novel, developed by one person. Inspired by authors such as Lynch, Ryukishi07 and King. Originally released on Itch.io in two parts, it was remade and improved in a single game. 
[Link in the comments]
